title: FEATURE COMPLETENESS & INTEGRATION AUDIT

features.summary: Create/read/update/delete, validation, pagination, filtering, ownership, balance impact, idempotency, anomaly detection, audit metadata, and controller/service behavior were validated in the transaction test suite.
Income create flow (frontend TransactionForm, syncCreateTransaction, backend transactions API) validated via headed E2E; exactly-once persistence and dashboard update verified.
Dashboard service/controller tests and analytics logic are present and executing successfully in the core backend suite.
Budget CRUD and service logic are covered by the backend suite, with no critical failure found in the audited modules.
Saving goals service/controller tests pass in the focused backend validation run.
Category module has controller coverage and no failures in the audited backend suite.
Reports and budget analytics services have dedicated regression and validation tests covering report generation and breakdown logic.
Notification and AI/finance-bot related services are implemented and the targeted backend suite passes; the bot remains non-toxic and non-claiming without evidence.
Audit log services and controller coverage are present and pass in the core backend validation run.
Auth module flows are covered by service and controller tests, including session, refresh token, and JWT-related scenarios.
The backend and mobile-oriented architecture are present, but repository evidence does not include a full PWA/offline validation suite or real mobile-device integration test coverage.
features.remaining_blocker: No explicit end-to-end PWA/mobile test harness or production mobile automation was found in the repo.

features.summary: The backend API modules and DTO/service/repository structure are coherent; core feature tests pass and TypeScript validation succeeds. The full suite is limited by a non-production transfer integration test that requires a real Postgres environment.
The tested services include failure handling, retry-safe logic, and race condition safeguards; no silent failure path was surfaced in the audited modules.
The current backend suite has broad module coverage and the core modules passed in the targeted validation run.
evidence: npx jest --runInBand src/modules/transactions src/modules/budgets src/modules/categories src/modules/saving-goals src/modules/dashboard src/modules/reports src/modules/notifications src/modules/auth --passWithNoTests

features.summary: The app uses integer minor-unit values and the transaction invariant tests confirm ledger arithmetic and financial invariants remain consistent in the validated path.
The backend is generally lightweight and avoids excessive logging, but no end-to-end mobile/perf benchmarking or production-like load validation was performed in the repo.
features.remaining_blocker: No explicit performance benchmark or real mobile/PWA instrumentation was available.

features.summary: The Phase F evidence package was created in the non-recovery evidence directory and records the final audit state and blockers.
